text: The army accepted its defeat and left the field.
translation: 军队承认败北，撤离了战场。
note: 败北是战败这个状态，不是一次具体战役。

text: Their defeat made the whole country change.
translation: 他们的败北让整个国家发生改变。
note: the defeat = 败北这件事。

text: The old leader never spoke of his defeat.
translation: 这位老领导人从不提自己的败北。
note: 他的败北 —— 名词用法。

text: Such a defeat would end the war at once.
translation: 这样的败北会立刻结束战争。
note: such a defeat 指战败的结果。

text: The news of the defeat reached the capital that night.
translation: 败北的消息当晚传到首都。
note: the news of the defeat。

text: The whole plan met its defeat on the first day.
translation: 整个计划第一天就失败了。
note: defeat 作名词表「失败」，主语不是军队。

text: Her last book was a defeat that nobody read.
translation: 她最后一本书是个没人看的失败作品。
note: 作品失败用 defeat，不用败北。

text: The long trip was a defeat for all of us.
translation: 那次长途旅行对我们所有人都是失败。
note: 非战事的失败。

text: She called the show a complete defeat from the start.
translation: 她说这个剧从一开始就彻底失败。
note: 剧本身失败。

text: The whole evening was a total defeat.
translation: 整个晚上彻底失败。
note: 社交场合的失败，不是战败。

text: Our army will defeat the enemy in three days.
translation: 我军将在三天内击败敌军。
note: defeat + 宾语 = 击败，宾语是被战胜的一方。

text: They voted to defeat the old plan at once.
translation: 他们投票立刻否决那个旧方案。
note: 击败一个方案 = 让它不通过。

text: No one can defeat him in a fair fight.
translation: 在公平战斗中没人能击败他。
note: 在战斗语境里 defeat 某人。

text: She worked hard to defeat her fear of the dark.
translation: 她努力工作以战胜对黑暗的恐惧。
note: 战胜一种情绪也用 defeat。

text: The new team defeated them by twenty points.
translation: 新队以二十分击败了他们。
note: 比分语境，defeat 是击败。

text: The rain defeated our plan to go out.
translation: 这场雨让我们的外出计划落了空。
note: 使计划落空 = 让期待泡汤，不是击败敌人。

text: A late train defeated all our careful plans.
translation: 一列晚点的火车让我们周密的计划全落空。
note: 客观因素使努力白费。

text: His busy week defeated every chance to rest.
translation: 他忙的一周让每个休息的机会都没了。
note: 使机会落空。

text: The bad road defeated our hope of arriving early.
translation: 这条烂路让我们早到的希望落空。
note: hope 落空这个义项最典型。

text: Thick clouds defeated the sun all week.
translation: 厚云整周遮住了太阳。
note: 使某物无法发挥作用 = 使落空。
